notes.title: Ashen Knights: One Passage - Moving Beyond
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Ashen Knights![/h2]

[h3]We announce the closure of the "Ashen Knights: One Passage" project. This version served as a demo for "Ashen Knights: Foreshadow" and will no longer be supported. The decision to disable it is due to the release of the full version of the game, which includes new chapters. We are confident that you will appreciate the extensive changes and improvements made to the game, and continue to enjoy our world and adventures in "Ashen Knights: Foreshadow".

Thank you for your support and understanding. We look forward to seeing you in the world of "Ashen Knights: Foreshadow", where new challenges and adventures await.[/h3]

[h2]Greetings, Valiant Knights![/h2]

[h3]We would like to remind you that Ashen Knights: Foreshadow is now available in Early Access! We will continue to support it and release regular updates. Don't forget that your participation and feedback are crucial to us. Together, we are creating the world of Ashen Knights and making it even more captivating!

notes.title: Ashen Knights: Foreshadow. Early Access Release!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Valiant Knights![/h2]

[h3]With great excitement, we announce that Ashen Knights: Foreshadow is finally available in Early Access! This moment has become possible thanks to the efforts of our development team, who have invested hundreds of hours of work and boundless passion into creating a new incredible world in the souls-like & hack’n’slash genre. We are proud to present to you the first three thrilling chapters of the story Campaign and four Unique Boss Battles!

But this is only the beginning of our journey! We promise to continue our work, gathering and analyzing your feedback and comments to make Ashen Knights: Foreshadow even better and more unique. Together, we will create not just a game, but a true adventure, full of excitement, thrilling battles, and emotions!

We thank you for your support and loyalty. Don't miss the opportunity to immerse yourself in this fantastic world and become part of the incredible story of Ashen Knights: Foreshadow![/h3]

notes.title: Release time, here we go! One Passage is out and waiting for you, Ashen Knight!
notes.content: What a long journey that was! What a fun journey that was! And finally, we’re at our destination point – the release. Merciless Primos and gracious Evelin, the Abyssal spawn and tricky bandits, regular mobs and mighty bosses – everything and everyone has finally arrived. Go through the first chapters of this grim story, fight and protect, solve and complete – do anything in this concentrated cocktail of Ashen Knights. Do it for free. Do it now. Play and enjoy, and come back for more in Foreshadow. Have a blast fighting, dear knights!

notes.title: Mark your calendars! Ashen Knights: One Passage goes live on August 17th
notes.content:
Oh, it is finally happening! Today is the day, when we officially announce the release date for Ashen Knights: One Passage – August 17th, 2023. Let’s celebrate the announcement together by watching the hot trailer for one of our protagonists – Primos.

This prologue is a proud standalone game that we put our hearts into. Sure, One Passage and Foreshadow partially overlap. However, the prologue will not only give its players the chance to be among the first to experience the dark world of Ashen Knights, but it will also immerse them in the unique blend of secrets and revelations, battles and puzzles, acts of valor and bitter betrayal. In other words, One Passage is a concentrated dose of the game. Play it at breakneck speed or explore it slowly, thoughtfully, bit by bit. You will get two very different kinds of gaming experiences. Replayability and a good, strong taste of what Ashen Knights is all about is what we are aiming for with this prologue. Hopefully, we’ll be able to get to the point where the players will both really enjoy playing One Passage and also crave more.

The prologue will be locked and loaded with three fairly large levels – the demo level that you can already install & play, and also two new levels - one per protagonist. Each level will feature a unique design, a set of original mobs and characters, and its own distinctive atmosphere.

So, yeah, if for some reason you and your friends haven’t wishlisted Ashen Knights: One Passage yet – please do. It is a very simple action that would tremendously help our game to stand out among other projects, and we’d be eternally grateful to you for your help.

Ashen Knights: One Passage. August 17. Free. Mark your calendars and stay awesome. Cheers!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest is coming to its end. Thank you for making it truly legendary!
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest may end, but our beloved memories of it will stay with us forever. We will always remember tons of fun we had discovering new great games, watching cozy livestreams, and playing engaging demos. We’ll also remember the excitement we had while launching the very first Ashen Knights demo, and playing through it during our broadcasts. Thank you so much for joining us in the fun, friends! If you had a chance to play Ashen Knights demo during this celebration of gaming, please share some feedback with us. All you need to do is complete this short survey. It is very simple and will take just about 7 minutes of your time. Thank you so much, you’re awesome!

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdoIrjdr4-KGoBOKvL194H0x9d8ERpkuJ_LV882yBqA6B2BgA/viewform

We really appreciate your help, friends. Cheers, and see you soon!

notes.title: Ashen Knights: One Passage | Livestreaming the Very First Game Demo
notes.content:
On February 11, 2023 at will begin the livestream of the very first demo for Ashen Knights: One Passage. The event will take place as part of Steam Next Fest. The creators of Ashen Knights will take you for a ride through a phantasmagoric dream of Evelin – one of the game protagonists. It is going to be a journey of battles and puzzles, hints and allusions, which will shed some light on Evelin's relationships with another central character – Primos. Join us to get a good taste of this top-down mixture of souls-like and hack’n’slash, set in a grim dark fantasy world. See you on the livestream!

notes.title: Ashen Knights brings its hack’n’slash & souls-like whirlwind to Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Ashen Knights is going full mode Steam Next Fest from February 6 through February 13, 2023. It is our very first Steam event, so we are excited to the point where it is hard to concentrate, think straight, and stay on our previously set course. Therefore, we brainstormed ourselves a plan for the event. Hopefully, it will help us enjoy Steam Next Fest as much as possible and will serve as a little guide to all who may read these letters. Without further ado, here’s a list of something we have planned for the Fest:
1). Share a free Ashen Knights: One Passage demo for players to enjoy
2). Release a tailor-made trailer; watch as many trailers and gameplay videos as possible
3). Have dev livestreams on Wednesday, the 8th,  and Saturday. the 11th
4). Have massive fun
5). Discover the next indie gem
Looks like a plan to us. Would be absolutely thrilling if any of you joins us in the fun. In any case, please enjoy your time, and come visit Evelin in her phantasmagoric dream in Ashen Knights: One Passage free demo. She might not show it, but she’ll really appreciate your visit. Cheers!
